relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine prevents transmission of pain signals by blocking NaV1.8 channels located along peripheral pain-sensing neurons

relationships.subject: peripheral pain-sensing neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: NaV1.8 is expressed in peripheral pain-sensing neurons but is not expressed in the brain.

key_findings: Suzetrigine, a selective NaV1.8 inhibitor, was approved in the USA on 30 January 2025 for moderate to severe acute pain
It is the first NaV inhibitor approved in this non-opioid analgesic class
